selection.edition: international Addressfinder AU/NZ/INT address, email, and phone APIs (Composio ADDRESSFINDER tools)
selection.ownership: Addressfinder Limited, Level 2, 1 Ghuznee Street, Te Aro, Wellington, New Zealand (NZ Company Number 8163685); Addressfinder Pty Limited ACN 606 672 333 for non-NZ contracts. The reviewed edition is the public HTTPS API at api.addressfinder.io serving AU and NZ, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Addressfinder authentication (API key query parameter plus Authorization secret for server-to-server), AU/NZ address autocomplete, billing (autocomplete keystrokes are not Lookups; metadata/verification consume Lookups), HTTP 200 {success:false,message,error_code} envelopes, Wellington/Sydney identity, SOC 2 Type 2 Trust Centre, and dated incident search for Addressfinder Limited security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Addressfinder AU/NZ address autocomplete API
research.searchCoverage: Official Addressfinder AU/NZ autocomplete at https://api.addressfinder.io with key+secret auth reviewed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Addressfinder Limited (Wellington) / Addressfinder Pty Limited. Autocomplete suggestions are not billed Lookups. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Addressfinder Limited security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise. Official Trust Centre publishes SOC 2 Type 2 and annual penetration testing.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

remainingGates: no dedicated account/quota JSON GET; healthcheck uses official unbilled NZ autocomplete q=test&max=1 matching the pinned validator
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Maps to official GET /au/address/autocomplete with required query and optional max (1-100).
Optional Composio filters source, post_box, canonical, state_codes, domain, highlight, and ascii are passed as scalar query bindings when set.
format=json is always sent; secret stays in the Authorization header.
GET /au/address/metadata. Supply id, gnaf_id, or dpid. format/secret are not caller inputs.
GET /au/address/v2/verification with required query mapped to q.
GET /{country}/address/v2/autocomplete. country is a required path segment from the documented ISO alpha-2 allowlist. max is 1-15.
GET /{country}/address/v2/metadata with required country path segment and id.
Maps to official GET /nz/address/autocomplete with required query and optional max (1-100).
Optional Composio filters delivered, post_box, rural, strict, region_code, domain, highlight, and ascii are passed as scalar query bindings when set.
format=json is always sent; secret stays in the Authorization header.
GET /nz/address/metadata. Supply pxid or dpid.
GET /nz/address/reverse_geocode with required WGS84 x (longitude) and y (latitude).
GET /nz/address/verification with required query mapped to q.
GET /email/v1/verification with required email. Optional features is a comma-separated official list.

Credential-only healthcheck maps to the pinned validator GET /nz/address/autocomplete?q=test&max=1. Official pricing: autocomplete keystrokes/suggestions are not billed Lookups; metadata after selection and verified verification are billed and are omitted.
format=json is always sent. HTTP 200 bodies with a non-empty message are demoted via bodyErrorPaths [message]. success is not used because true would trip a boolean path.
Returns raw Addressfinder JSON under data instead of the pinned {success,completions,meta,raw} wrapper. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
GET /au/location/autocomplete with required query mapped to q.
GET /au/location/metadata with required id.
GET /nz/location/autocomplete with required query. street/suburb/city/region filters are additive 0/1 flags.
GET /nz/location/metadata with required pxid.
GET /phone/v1/verification with required phone_number and default_country_code. Optional mobile_only is a boolean query flag.
GET /nz/points_of_interest/autocomplete (official path; Composio slug is NZ POI Autocomplete).
GET /nz/points_of_interest/metadata with required id.
